description: Expected results for the official GEOPHIRES-X example1 (EGS, multiple parallel fractures reservoir at 3 km, Ramey wellbore model, supercritical ORC electricity, 30-year life, fixed charge rate economics). inputs/example1.txt and reference/example1.out are the unmodified files from the GEOPHIRES-X git tree (tests/examples/). All expected values are read FROM THE OFFICIAL reference/example1.out, not from our run.

official_comparison.what: Same check as the GEOPHIRES-X test suite (tests/test_geophires_x.py::test_geophires_examples): parse both the new .out and the official example1.out with geophires_x_client.GeophiresXResult, drop 'metadata' and 'Simulation Metadata' (version, date, run time), and require the two result dicts to be exactly equal.
official_comparison.tolerance: exact (example1 is not in the suite's almost-equal fallback list)

numeric_checks.name: average_reservoir_heat_extraction_MW
numeric_checks.why: average heat taken from the reservoir

numeric_checks.name: power_profile_years
numeric_checks.why: one row per year of the 30-year plant life

numeric_checks.name: final_year_pct_total_heat_mined
numeric_checks.profile: HEAT AND/OR ELECTRICITY EXTRACTION AND GENERATION PROFILE
numeric_checks.why: share of reservoir heat used after 30 years

numeric_checks.name: final_net_cashflow_MUSD
numeric_checks.why: cumulative cash position at end of life

finished_normally: run_geophires.py exits 0 with status 'success', and the .out starts with the '***CASE REPORT***' banner
ki_parser_cross_check: the KI tools/parse_geophires_output.py must give the same Average Net Electricity Production, Electricity breakeven price, Project NPV and Project IRR as the official parser
recorded_with: values read from the official GEOPHIRES-X tests/examples/example1.out (git 870971c8); confirmed by real runs of GEOPHIRES-X 3.11.25 (venv /home/server/knowledge-dissection-toolkit/auto_dissect/_work/GEOPHIRES/venv) through the KI tools/run_geophires.py. Two clean runs gave result dicts exactly equal to the official file (only version/date/run time lines differ).
reference: reference/example1.out (official GEOPHIRES-X expected output, written by GEOPHIRES 3.9.28; the suite still uses it unchanged as the expected result for 3.11.25)
